## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:spec`, `pm:blocked` on PR #23290. Three package-axis gaps on the delete and draft doors, as one family. Item 3 widens the delete's accept set, so the family is spec-lane work

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-13T16:00Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2:**
  - item 1 is read, not measured: the registry may drop an item the store still serves;
  - item 2 is the storage-order pick #23165 removed from the direct save, still on the draft save;
  - item 3 is fail-closed: it over-refuses.
  
  None leaks.
- **Lane:**
  - Item 3 lets `DELETE …?package=P` through when only Q's copy is locked. That admits a request the door refuses today, so `Clause-②: yes`: spec-lane work with contract-tier review, whichever seat found it.
  - Items 1 and 2 keep or narrow what the doors accept. They ride the same family branch.
  - The edits are in `packages/metadata-protocol` (`protocol.ts`, `sys-metadata-repository.ts`), declared in the claim.
- **Why blocked:** PR #23290 changes the same two doors, and the card names that order.

Blocked-by: #23290
Restart-when: PR #23290 has merged.

- **Direction: the card's "Wanted", as written.**
  - Item 1's probe comes first; close item 1 with the measurement if the registry keeps the item.
  - Item 2 refuses with the `?package=` remedy, unless measurement shows the author's package can be named.
  - Item 3 hands `packageId` through to `getEffectiveLock`, at the save gate's parity.
  - Each item has a negative control.

## Unlock scan: `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue`. `Blocked-by: #23290` is satisfied: PR #23290 (#23165's fix) merged as `543b33dee6`

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-13T16:08Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- Re-derived at this act. The merge was at 2026-10-13T15:54Z. #23165 is closed. The grade, lane and direction in this seat's first-grade note above stand.
- At claim, re-read the doors on the then-current `main`. The card's readings were taken at the PR's head `b546c5ff2`, not at the merge.

  - `restoreArtifactRegistryView` (item 1, and only if item 1's probe shows the registry drops the item);
  - `assertLockAllowsDelete` and its `getEffectiveLock` call (item 3).
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts` `resolveWriteHead` (item 2).
- Tests: each item pinned, each with a negative control. One `.changeset/23297-*.md`.
- The cross-domain file family is held here because item 3 is `Clause-②: yes`, per triage.
- **Amended in place at ACCEPT** (the dev report on this card, measured):
  - `Clause-②` reads `yes (narrowing)`. Item 2 narrows the draft door (`200` → `409`), item 1 widens the registry after a per-package delete, and item 3 measurably admits nothing. The PR body and the changeset carry the same line.
  - In `protocol.ts`, beyond the two regions: the `./sys-metadata-repository.js` import line; `packagelessAddressAmbiguityRefusal`, moved into `sys-metadata-repository.ts` so item 2 reuses the one sentence; and one stale comment line in the `packagelessAddress` docblock. All are disjoint from PR #23358 and PR #23375.
  - Two existing `metadata-protocol` pins changed: the write-through call-site count (6 → 7), and the view-container heal fixture.
  - New tests in `packages/objectql/src/` (`protocol-delete-object-registry-heal.test.ts`, `protocol-lock-artifact-package-axis.test.ts`): tests only, cross-lane `domain:engine`.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: "no path-derived mandate … floor · default · ceiling"); the review before the queue runs at the ceiling, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (reason: `Clause-②: yes`, item 3 widens the delete door's accept set).
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Responsibility: `metadata-protocol`'s delete and draft-save doors, which do not take the package they are handed | none: the direct save and the delete were fixed by #23165, and the draft save and the delete's lock gate were left out | any author naming `?package=` on a two-package item; item 3 is fail-closed (it over-refuses), and item 1 is read from source, not measured
Thread-read: 6149850778
Serial constraints cleared: open PRs' file lists read in this act.
- PR #23358 (#23316, seat 3) edits `protocol.ts` at the meta read and list regions (hunks near `:6569`, `:10263`, `:11093` and `:15409`–`:15490`).
- PR #23375 (#23312, this seat) edits `permissionSetOwnerBindingRefusal` (near `:956`).
- This card's regions (near `:18581` and `:20336`) intersect neither: ordinary concurrency, and the later lander merges `main`.
- No open PR touches `sys-metadata-repository.ts`.

## ✅ ACCEPT (seat review): PR #23408 at `ae6b35c16` (`Fixes #23297`). It queues after one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS on its head and a green head · 2026-10-14T07:08Z

`domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · `huangyiirene` · session `session_01YRp5z4kK6vgYkrdH97ztsy`. The dev report is `6162849757`; the claim is `6160266617`, amended in place in this act.

**Read on GitHub, not from the report:**
- **PR shape:** draft, base `main`, `mergeable_state: clean`. First body line `Fixes #23297`, line 2 `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`. The body has no other closing keyword next to a card number.
- **Files:** 9 changed (`+533 / -58`).
- **Landing class:** `check-governed-merges --pr 23408` reads NOT governed.
- **The changeset, read sentence by sentence against the diff:** `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` minor, BREAKING. It states each item's FROM → TO and the remedy (`?package=` on a draft save of a two-package item). Its ADR-0087 disposition is `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, with the reason that no stored row or authorable spelling moves.

**The three items:**
- **Item 1** (the registry heal after a per-package delete): fixed. Before the fix, data GET and POST answered `404 OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` after `DELETE ...?package=P`; after it, `200` and `201`. This was measured on a booted showcase.
- **Item 2** (the draft save with two packages): fixed. A package-less draft save of a two-package item is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with #23165's `?package=` sentence, which moved into the repository module instead of being copied. The one-package control still saves.
- **Item 3** (the delete's lock gate): the package is now handed through, at the save gate's parity, as triage directed. The card's premise that this admits `?package=P` is false by measurement: the save naming P is refused exactly as the delete is, under the #21761 / #21803 strictest-across-packages rule. So item 3 changes the refusal's prose only.

**`open_questions` (item 3), answered A: keep the ruled rule, with no follow-up card.**
- A package-addressed lock would reverse #21803 weeks after it landed, and would give the lock two answers that depend on the request's spelling.
- No measured producer needs it: no example app declares an item lock.
- If a named user need appears, it is filed then, as its own decision.

**`Clause-②`:** the claim's `yes` is amended to `yes (narrowing)`, the line the PR body and the changeset carry. The repo's `readClause2Line` reads it as `declared / yes / narrowing`.

**File surface, amended:** the `protocol.ts` import line, the moved refusal sentence and one comment line (all disjoint from PR #23358 and PR #23375); two existing pins; and the two new `objectql` test files.

**Out-of-scope findings, through the filing gate:**
- **`dropStorage=true` on a per-package delete drops the object table while another package's row remains** (measured, data loss): filed #23415, flagged data-integrity for triage.
- **A second package's save of a runtime-authored object answers `200` while the registry refuses the ownership** (measured, ADR-0029 D9.9): filed #23416.
- **The restore and raw-delete paths read the active row with no package predicate** (read from source, not measured): Acceptance notes.
- **The package-less draft save's receipt does not name the inherited package:** Acceptance notes.

**Next:**
- A `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review runs when a slot frees: the seat runs at batch 2 on the maintainer's word.
- The PR touches no regenerated path, so no regen-merge is owed. It merges `main` only if it drifts into conflict.
